name: Moped
description: A moped or motorized bicycle: two or three wheels, a motor under 4 gross brake horsepower (3,000 W), and a top speed of 30 mph on level ground.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels and an automatic transmission; pedals are optional
Two or three wheels; pedals are optional
restrictions.citation: California Vehicle Code §406, as amended by SB 1167 (2026)

restrictions.rule: Its motor produces less than 4 gross brake horsepower (3,000 W)
restrictions.citation: California Vehicle Code §406, as amended by SB 1167 (2026)

restrictions.rule: Can't propel it faster than 30 mph on level ground
Built for highway use: meets federal motor vehicle safety standards, with a 17-digit VIN and a safety certification label
restrictions.citation: California Vehicle Code §406, as amended by SB 1167 (2026)

restrictions.rule: Riders need a driver's license with an M1 or M2 motorcycle endorsement, so must be 16 or older
Riders must wear a motorcycle helmet
Registered with the DMV and carries a moped plate; registering it doesn't require insurance
Barred from any freeway or expressway where Caltrans or the local authority posts a prohibition
Kept off bike paths and trails unless they run beside a roadway or a local ordinance allows it
A vehicle, not property: it can be towed or impounded
